phases.title: Mesocycle 1 — Rebuild the Catch
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–6: receiving positions, full extension, confident turnover and repeatable footwork. Week 6 builds to heavy with technique as the limit.

intent.title: Week 1 · Build the Receiving Shape
intent.text: Catch width, lockout and confident receiving.

exercises.name: High-hang power snatch + OHS
exercises.note: Finish the leg drive; lock arms immediately and squat without jumping wider. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: PVC or empty bar, high-hang power receive then controlled squat. Do not force a deep catch.

exercises.name: Back squat, 3-sec eccentric
exercises.note: Stable whole foot; knees follow toes throughout the descent. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: PVC overhead squat hold (2 sec)
exercises.note: Lock elbows; bar over mid‐foot. Optional if time remains. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Stay in control; shoulders rotate without shrugging.

mobility.name: Band W rows
mobility.note: Elbows high, rotate forearms up

primer.name: Drop snatch (PVC / empty bar) + OHS
primer.note: PVC or empty bar by control; hold the catch for 2 sec.

exercises.name: High-hang clean + split jerk
exercises.note: Secure rack before dipping; split and hold 2 sec. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: high-hang power clean + front squat; practice jerk footwork with PVC separately.

exercises.name: Front squat, 3-sec eccentric
exercises.note: Elbows high; knees travel in line with feet. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Light DB front-rack march
exercises.note: Brace, no torso sway; optional. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Two distinct tracks, not tightrope; front foot lands flat.

mobility.name: Split jerk footwork steps
mobility.note: Two tracks, stick the landing

primer.name: Tall clean + unloaded split freeze
primer.note: Fast elbows, then balanced feet; mark landing positions.

exercises.name: Below-knee hang snatch, knee pause
exercises.note: Pause 1 sec balanced at knee; push and accelerate to hip. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: work above knee. If the bar drifts, reset at high hang rather than adding weight.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Own the bottom; smooth ascent with no knee collapse. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: DB RDL (light)
exercises.note: Feel leg drive and controlled hinge; optional. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Knees track; feel even pressure beneath both feet.

mobility.name: Ankle rocks
mobility.note: Heel down, smooth range

primer.name: Segment snatch pull to knee
primer.note: One-second knee pause; long arms and bar close.

exercises.name: Pause-at-knee clean + split jerk
exercises.note: Patient to knee, aggressive leg drive, fast elbows, vertical dip. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: above-knee clean and empty-bar split rehearsal if the pause disrupts balance.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Elbows lead up; chest remains supported. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Jerk split recovery rehearsal
exercises.note: Practice confident, balanced recovery; sandbag was in warm‐up. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Sandbag: legs first, close load, finish tall; med‐ball scoop toss if needed.

mobility.name: Light sandbag clean
mobility.note: Leg drive first. Scale to med-ball scoop toss (2×2) if needed.

primer.name: Paused clean pull + split-foot steps
primer.note: Arms long through knee; land on separate tracks.

intent.title: Week 3 · Extend, Then Commit
intent.text: Long arms, fast turnover and a predictable landing.

exercises.name: Hang snatch + floor snatch
exercises.note: Recreate the same footprint and complete extension in both starts. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: two high-hang singles rather than a floor combination until both catches are committed.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Deliberate lower; track knees through the sticking point. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Side plank + top-leg lift
exercises.note: Pelvis level; short optional hip-control dose. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Wake up hips and shoulders without fatigue.

mobility.name: Thoracic reaches
mobility.note: Controlled upper-back rotation

primer.name: Tall snatch + 2-sec overhead hold
primer.note: Fast turnover, full elbow lock, no unnecessary foot jump.

exercises.name: Hang clean + floor clean + jerk
exercises.note: Two clean receives, one deliberate split; shorten complex if needed. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: one hang clean followed by an unloaded split; no complex beyond attention span.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Keep elbows high while driving out of the hole. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Suitcase carry
exercises.note: Light, steady torso; optional. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Foot angle and rear-knee bend remain consistent.

mobility.name: Split jerk recovery steps
mobility.note: Recover front foot halfway back, then bring rear foot forward

primer.name: Tall clean + rack hold
primer.note: Turn elbows around quickly; stand only after a balanced catch.

exercises.name: No-foot power snatch
exercises.note: Use the drill to eliminate backward kicks, not to eliminate normal foot movement forever. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: PVC or empty bar; film a successful landing and compare with Week 1.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Easy speed; no grind or positional compensation. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Controlled DB overhead hold
exercises.note: Only if pain-free; otherwise scapular band work. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Stay balanced on mid-foot; do not force extra range.

mobility.name: Supported hip airplanes
mobility.note: Small, balanced range of motion

primer.name: PVC snatch balance + OHS hold
primer.note: Punch to locked elbows; hold 2 sec in the bottom.

exercises.name: Clean + 2-sec catch hold + jerk
exercises.note: Freeze rack before dip; move confidently to the split. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: use power catch + controlled squat; separate footwork from jerk loading.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Smooth descent; full foot remains planted. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Jerk split recovery + video note
exercises.note: No extra squat volume; confirm two‐track split on video. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. 1 light set each; W row = high row then rotate forearms up.

mobility.name: Band W rows
mobility.note: Elbows high, rotate forearms up

primer.name: Tall clean + jerk footwork on tape
primer.note: Fast elbows and steady split geometry.

intent.title: Week 5 · Return to the Full Lift

exercises.name: Snatch from floor
exercises.note: Long arms to extension; receive in the same balanced footprint. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: high hang or blocks. Successful confident receiving beats a heavier floor rep.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Leave 1-3 clean reps in reserve. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Light band external rotation
exercises.note: Shoulder maintenance; optional. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Track knees, ribs stacked beneath bar.

mobility.name: Overhead reaches
mobility.note: Reach without flaring ribs

primer.name: No-foot high-hang snatch
primer.note: Finish vertical drive without the feet shooting backward.

exercises.name: Clean & split jerk from floor
exercises.note: Finish through upper thigh; stand and reset before a decisive jerk. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: power clean + clean front squat at controllable load; PVC/empty-bar jerk.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Strong rack; evenly loaded feet. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: DB front-rack hold
exercises.note: Optional easy bracing, not a fatigue test. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Preview rear-foot landing; two tracks.

mobility.name: Split jerk footwork steps
mobility.note: Two tracks, stick the landing

primer.name: Tall clean + tall jerk drill
primer.note: Fast rack then rapid arms without an excessive press-out.

intent.title: Week 6 · Build to Heavy
intent.text: Heaviest technically excellent lift, not a max-out. A PR or an 80% lift with excellent form are equally successful; no required max.

exercises.name: Snatch: BUILD TO HEAVY
exercises.note: Build only while lockout, width and confidence remain excellent; no prescribed %. · Beginner: build to a best repeatable technical rep, even if it is an empty bar. · A great rep at 80% is as successful as a great PR. Stop before form deteriorates.

exercises.name: Back squat, light technique sets
exercises.note: Smooth and fast, several reps in reserve. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Coach technique notes
exercises.note: Film / record best made rep and the quality of catch, lockout, feet and extension.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Calm, familiar setup and full-foot balance.

mobility.name: Squat-to-stand
mobility.note: Balance at midfoot

primer.name: Tall snatch + bottom freeze
primer.note: Fast elbows, firm lockout, committed receiving.

exercises.name: Clean & jerk: BUILD TO HEAVY
exercises.note: Only increase with decisive rack, clear jerk lockout and stable split. · Beginner: use high-hang clean and an appropriate jerk variation; stop at first loss of confidence. · A great rep at 80% is as successful as a great PR. Stop before form deteriorates.

exercises.name: Front squat, light technique sets
exercises.note: No grind. Strength is not the benchmark today. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Coach technique notes
exercises.note: Film / record best made rep and the quality of catch, lockout, feet and extension.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Find front foot and heel position before warming.

mobility.name: Jerk track steps
mobility.note: Repeat front and rear foot landing

primer.name: Tall clean + split freeze
primer.note: Elbows through; stable split and straight arms.

phases.title: Mesocycle 2 — Express the Lift
phases.subtitle: Weeks 7–12: faster pull-under, consistent catch positions, meaningful loads and a true same-day Olympic total.

intent.title: Week 7 · Reset for Reactive Speed
intent.text: React and receive at moderate loads.

exercises.name: High-hang snatch + floor snatch
exercises.note: Match catch width and receiving confidence in both positions. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: high-hang power snatch + OHS, then separate light singles.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Rebuild volume; steady tempo with 2+ reps in reserve. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Light DB waiter carry
exercises.note: Only if overhead is stable and pain-free. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Warm hips and rotator cuff without fatigue.

mobility.name: Band W rows
mobility.note: Elbows high, rotate forearms up

primer.name: Tall snatch into 2-sec hold
primer.note: Instant lockout; feet land quietly.

exercises.name: High-hang clean + split jerk
exercises.note: No unnecessary kick-back; secure rack and commit to the split. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: high-hang power clean then jerk step-to-split without load.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Smooth front rack; controlled volume. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Light DB front-rack carry
exercises.note: Optional: ribs over pelvis, no lean. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Two-track landing and front-foot balance.

mobility.name: Line split steps
mobility.note: Two-track split

primer.name: Tall clean + dry split jerk
primer.note: Fast elbows and simultaneous punch/feet.

intent.title: Week 8 · Power Through the Hip
intent.text: Speed above knee and a completed hip finish.

exercises.name: Above-knee hang snatch
exercises.note: Violent leg drive without an early curl; pull under as bar rises. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: high hang or power catch, then controlled overhead squat.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Repeat depth and stable knee line. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Banded face pull
exercises.note: Optional light upper-back activity. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Controlled hips, open shoulders.

mobility.name: Dynamic lat stretch
mobility.note: Gentle overhead reach without fatigue

primer.name: Snatch-grip segment pull
primer.note: Patient to knee, long arms, finish tall.

exercises.name: Above-knee hang clean + split jerk
exercises.note: Bar close to upper thigh, fast elbow turnover, vertical jerk. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: muscle clean / high-hang catch with light jerk footwork.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Avoid elbow drop on last rep. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Jerk footwork quality review
exercises.note: Sandbag clean is in the warm‐up; keep finish low fatigue. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Finish leg extension before pulling under; scale to med‐ball scoop toss.

mobility.name: Light sandbag clean
mobility.note: Leg drive first. Scale to med-ball scoop toss (2×2) if needed.

primer.name: Clean high-pull shape + tape-track split
primer.note: Finish legs before arms; do not jump back.

exercises.name: Snatch from floor, 1-sec knee pause
exercises.note: Stay over bar, push through legs, no wild foot spread. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: below-knee hang with the same pause; no loaded position they cannot hold.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Strong ascent; stop before form changes. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Short side plank
exercises.note: Optional trunk control. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Hips steady; feel mid-foot pressure.

mobility.name: Supported single-leg hinge
mobility.note: Steady hip and foot pressure

primer.name: Pause-at-knee snatch deadlift
primer.note: Hold knee position 1 sec, then extend without curling.

exercises.name: Clean from floor, 1-sec pause + jerk
exercises.note: Balance through the knee, elbows through, commit to jerk. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: clean above knee, then light split drill; no compromised pause.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Drive tall with elbows high. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Light DB front-rack carry
exercises.note: Optional no-side-bend bracing. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Match knees with feet and repeat landing spots.

mobility.name: Split-foot stick drills
mobility.note: Quiet, balanced landing

primer.name: Pause-at-knee clean pull + tall clean
primer.note: No rushed knee passage; elbows are fast after extension.

exercises.name: Snatch from floor
exercises.note: Push from floor; bar accelerates past knee; finish and receive. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: use 60-70% or RPE 6, even if established lifters progress past 80%.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Keep 1-2 reps in reserve; zero grinding. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.note: Low-fatigue optional finish. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Knee alignment + shoulder external‐rotation control.

mobility.name: Band W rows
mobility.note: Elbows high, rotate forearms up

primer.name: Tall snatch, lockout freeze
primer.note: Quick punch under, no soft elbows.

exercises.name: Clean & split jerk from floor
exercises.note: No arm pull early. Rack securely before split, punch to lock. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: high-hang clean + light jerk; meet the bar and stand decisively.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Full-foot pressure under a stable rack. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Controlled step-down
exercises.note: Light, optional; track knee over mid-foot. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Balanced front foot, rear knee slightly bent.

mobility.name: Split jerk recovery rehearsal
mobility.note: Return to standing in sequence

primer.name: Tall clean + empty-bar jerk dip
primer.note: Fast elbows; straight vertical dip.

exercises.name: Snatch from floor
exercises.note: Advance only on completely stable makes; no grinding or press-out. · Based on SN 1RM · Beginner: RPE 6-7 with repeatable catches; skip near-max percentages.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.note: Fast reps, at least 2 reps in reserve. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Easy external rotation
exercises.note: Optional only; arrive fresh for total week. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Use light tension only before heavy singles.

mobility.name: Band W rows
mobility.note: Elbows high, rotate forearms up

primer.name: No-foot high-hang snatch
primer.note: Reinforce a quiet, repeatable receiving footprint.

exercises.name: Clean & split jerk from floor
exercises.note: No hesitation in rack or jerk; sharp lockout. · Based on CJ 1RM · Beginner: RPE 6-7 and well-controlled receiving; no pressure to reach 90%.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.note: Clean positions, 2+ reps in reserve. · Based on FS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Easy suitcase carry
exercises.note: Optional low-fatigue finish. · OPTIONAL if class time allows; skip before rushing primary work.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Same two tracks; no stiff back leg.

mobility.name: Light split steps
mobility.note: No bar required

primer.name: Tall clean + dry split jerk
primer.note: Confidence under the bar and crisp feet.

intent.title: Week 12 · Taper + Saturday Total
intent.text: Monday primer and Saturday same-day Olympic total. Monday prepares; Saturday scores best snatch + best clean & jerk on the same day.

exercises.name: Fast snatch singles from floor
exercises.note: Crisp and easy: all makes, no heavy attempts, no missed reps. · Based on SN 1RM

exercises.name: Back squat, very easy
exercises.note: Explosive intent, minimal fatigue; skip if needed. · Based on BS 1RM · Independent self-paced work (coach circulates).

exercises.name: Attempt planning / mobility
exercises.note: Plan warm-up jumps and openers; keep Monday easy. Optional low-fatigue mobility.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: Short, level steps; knees follow toes. Finish warm, not tired. Skip any irritating range.

mobility.name: Overhead reach + ankle rocks
mobility.note: Gentle range only

primer.name: Tall snatch + OHS hold
primer.note: Set stance and punch to a decisive lockout.

exercises.name: Snatch — official attempts
exercises.note: 17–31 min: up to 3 official attempts, after snatch warm-ups (08–17 min). Best made snatch counts toward Saturday total. No forced misses.

exercises.name: Clean & Jerk — official attempts
exercises.note: 40–57 min: up to 3 official attempts after C&J warm-ups (31–40 min). Add best made C&J to best made snatch. No squats.

mobility.name: Lateral band walk
mobility.note: A little warmth, no fatigue; test-day prep
